EQ.3: self-weighted SPR

english:
A flag for turning ON/OFF mass scaling for ALE parts.  The global mass scaling control (parameter DT2MS under *CONTROL_ TIMESTEP card) must be ON.  If the run dt is lower than the mass scaling dt, then IMASCL has the following effects:
EQ.0: (Default) No mass scaling for ALE parts.  Print out maximum 20 warnings. 
EQ.1: No mass scaling for ALE parts.  Stop the run. 
EQ.2: Do mass scaling for ALE parts (the result may not be correct due to this scaling).
EQ.3:	No mass scaling for ALE parts.  Use the ALE time step.  This time step may be small enough to substantially increase the calculations run time.
localized:
控制 ALE 部件质量缩放开关的标志。必须开启全局质量缩放控制（*CONTROL_TIMESTEP 卡片中的 DT2MS 参数）。如果计算时间步 dt 低于质量缩放时间步 dt，IMASCL 的作用如下：
EQ.0：默认值，不对 ALE 部件进行质量缩放，最多打印 20 条警告。
EQ.1：不对 ALE 部件进行质量缩放，停止计算。
EQ.2：对 ALE 部件进行质量缩放（这种缩放可能使结果不正确）。
EQ.3：不对 ALE 部件进行质量缩放，使用 ALE 时间步。该时间步可能很小，从而显著增加计算运行时间。（原文所有格符号含编码乱码，需核对来源）。

english:
ALL: All exterior segments will be included in the set.
BOX:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elements, one segment per shell is generated. For solid elements, only those segments wrapping the solid part and pointing outward from the part will be generated.
BOX_SHELL:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  The segments are only generated for shell elements.  One segment per shell is generated.
BOX_SLDIO:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Both exterior segments and inter-element segments are generated.
BOX_SOLID:Generate segments inside boxes having IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.  The segments are only generated for exterior solid elements.
BRANCH:Generate segments from tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elementsSET one segment is generated per shell.  For solid elements, only those segments that wrap the solid part and point outward from the part will be generated.  See *SET_PART_TREE.
BRANCH_IO:Generate segments from tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Same as the BRANCH option above, except that inter-element segments inside parts will be generated as well.  This option is sometimes useful for preventing negative volumes when using single surface contact between solid elements.
BRSLDFi:Generate segments from the ith face of solid tree branches E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  See Table 0-1 below for the face definition.
DBOX: Segments inside boxes with IDs E1, , E7 will be excluded.
DBOX_SHELL: Shell-related segments inside boxes of IDs E1, , and E7 will be excluded.
DBOX_SOLID: Solid-related segments inside boxes of IDs E1, , and E7 will be excluded.
DPART: Segments of parts with IDs E1, , and E7 will be excluded.
DSEG: Segment with node IDs  E1, E2, E3, and E4 will be deleted.
DSET: Segments of segment sets (*SET_SEGMENT) with IDs E1, E2, E3 will be excluded. 
DVOL: Segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, , and E7 will be excluded. 
DVOL_SHELL: Shell-related segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, , and E7 will be excluded. 
DVOL_SOLID: Solid-related segments inside contact volumes having IDs E1, , and E7 will be excluded. 
PART: Generate segments from parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  For shell elements, one segment per shell is generated.  For solid elements, only those segments wrapping the solid part and pointing outward from the part will be generated.  PART could refer to beam parts when defining 2D segments for traction application. 
PART_IO: Generate segments from parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  Same as the PART option above except that inter-element segments inside parts will be generated as well.  This option is sometimes useful for single surface contact of solid elements to prevent negative volumes. 
PSLDFi: Generate segments from the ith face of solid parts E1, E2, and E3 with attributes E4, E5, E6, and E7.  See Table 0-1 below for face definition. 
SALEBOXL Segments inside a box in a structured ALE(S - ALE) mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to XMIN, XMAX, YMIN, YMAX, ZMIN, and ZMAX, respectively.They are the minimum and the maximum nodal local coordinates, as defined in* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS, along each direction in S - ALE mesh.This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SALECPT Segments inside a box in a structured ALE(S - ALE) mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN, JMAX, KMIN, and KMAX.They are the minimum and the maximum nodal indices along each direction in the S - ALE mesh.This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SALEFAC Segments on the face of an S - ALE mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to - X, +X, -Y, +Y, -Z, +Z faces.Assigning 1 to these 6 values would include all the surface segments at these faces in the segment set.This option is only to be used for S - ALE meshes..It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.
For trimmed S - ALE meshes(see * ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM), a segment is treated as a surface segment as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.The set thus includes all surface segments facing that direction at the exterior and interior boundaries.
Refer to* ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.
SEG : Create a segment with node IDs E1, E2, E3, and E4.
SET : Segments of segment sets(*SET_SEGMENT) with IDs E1, E2, E3 will be included.
SET_SHELL : Generate segments from shell elements in shell sets created with* SET_SHELL_LIST with IDs E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.
SET_SOLID : Generate segments from solid elements in solid sets created with* SET_SOLID_LIST with IDs E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.
SET_SLDIO : Generate segments for solid elements in solid sets created with* SET_SOLID_LIST with IDs E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.Both exterior and interior segments are generated.
SET_SLDFi : Generate segments from the ith face of solid elements in the solid element sets created with* SET_SOLID_LIST with IDs E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.See Table 0 - 1 below for face definitions.
SET_TSHELL : Generate segments from thick shell elements in the thick shell sets created with* SET_TSHELL_LIST with IDs of E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.Only exterior segments are generated.
SET_TSHIO : Generate segments from thick shell elements in the thick shell sets created with* SET_TSHELL_LIST with IDs of E1, E2, and E3.E4, E5, E6, and E7 set the attributes.Both exterior and interior segments are generated.
SHELL : Generate segments for shell elements with IDs of E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.
VOL : Generate segments inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.See BOX option for other details.See* DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME.
VOL_SHELL : Generate segments from shells inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7
VOL_SLDIO : Generate segments from solid elements inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.See BOX_SLDIO for other details.
VOL_SOLID : Generate segments from solid elements inside contact volume IDs E1, E2, and E3 with attributes having values E4, E5, E6, and E7.See BOX_SOLID for other details.
localized:
ALL：将所有外表面段纳入集合。
BOX：在 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的盒区域内生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。每个壳单元生成一个段；实体单元仅生成包围实体部件且指向部件外侧的段。
BOX_SHELL：在 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的盒区域内生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。仅针对壳单元生成，每个壳单元生成一个段。
BOX_SLDIO：在 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的盒区域内生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。既生成外表面段，也生成单元间的段。
BOX_SOLID：在 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的盒区域内生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。仅针对外表面的实体单元生成段。
BRANCH：从树分支 E1、E2、E3 生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。每个壳单元生成一个段；实体单元仅生成包围实体部件且指向部件外侧的段。参见 *SET_PART_TREE。
BRANCH_IO：从树分支 E1、E2、E3 生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。与 BRANCH 相同，但还生成部件内部的单元间段。在实体单元之间使用单面接触时，此选项有时有助于防止负体积。
BRSLDFi：从实体树分支 E1、E2、E3 的第 i 个面生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。面的定义参见下文表 0-1。
DBOX：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的盒区域内的段。
DBOX_SHELL：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的盒区域内与壳相关的段。
DBOX_SOLID：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的盒区域内与实体相关的段。
DPART：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的部件的段。
DSEG：删除节点 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、E4 的段。
DSET：排除 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、... 的段集（*SET_SEGMENT）中的段。
DVOL：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的接触体积内的段。
DVOL_SHELL：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的接触体积内与壳相关的段。
DVOL_SOLID：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的接触体积内与实体相关的段。
PART：从部件 E1、E2、E3 生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。每个壳单元生成一个段；实体单元仅生成包围实体部件且指向部件外侧的段。为施加面力而定义二维段时，PART 可指梁部件。
PART_IO：从部件 E1、E2、E3 生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。与 PART 相同，但还生成部件内部的单元间段。在实体单元单面接触中，此选项有时有助于防止负体积。
PSLDFi：从实体部件 E1、E2、E3 的第 i 个面生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。面的定义参见下文表 0-1。
SALEBOXL：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格盒区域内的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 XMIN、XMAX、YMIN、YMAX、ZMIN、ZMAX，即 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 中定义的 S-ALE 网格各方向的最小和最大节点局部坐标。仅用于 S-ALE 网格，可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 配合，但不应与其他 GENERAL 选项配合。更多详情参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SALECPT：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格盒区域内的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX、KMIN、KMAX，即 S-ALE 网格各方向的最小和最大节点索引。仅用于 S-ALE 网格，可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 配合，但不应与其他 GENERAL 选项配合。更多详情参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SALEFAC：S-ALE 网格表面上的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 对应 -X、+X、-Y、+Y、-Z、+Z 面。将这 6 个值设为 1，可将相应面上的所有表面段纳入段集。仅用于 S-ALE 网格，可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 配合，但不应与其他 GENERAL 选项配合。
对于裁剪后的 S-ALE 网格（参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM），只要某段在指定方向上没有相邻单元，就将其视为表面段。因此集合包含朝向该方向的所有表面段，包括外边界和内边界。更多详情参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SEG：创建节点 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、E4 的段。
SET：纳入 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、... 的段集（*SET_SEGMENT）中的段。
SET_SHELL：从 *SET_SHELL_LIST 创建、ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的壳单元集中的壳单元生成段。E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SOLID：从 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建、ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的实体单元集中的实体单元生成段。E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。

BOX_SHELL：在 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的盒区域内生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。仅针对壳单元生成，每个壳单元生成一个段。

BRANCH：从树分支 E1、E2、E3 生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。每个壳单元生成一个段；实体单元仅生成包围实体部件且指向部件外侧的段。参见 *SET_PART_TREE。
BRANCH_IO：从树分支 E1、E2、E3 生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。与 BRANCH 相同，但还生成部件内部的单元间段。在实体单元之间使用单面接触时，此选项有时有助于防止负体积。
BRSLDFi：从实体树分支 E1、E2、E3 的第 i 个面生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。面的定义参见下文表 0-1。
DBOX：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的盒区域内的段。
DBOX_SHELL：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的盒区域内与壳相关的段。
DBOX_SOLID：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的盒区域内与实体相关的段。
DPART：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的部件的段。
DSEG：删除节点 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、E4 的段。
DSET：排除 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、... 的段集（*SET_SEGMENT）中的段。
DVOL：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的接触体积内的段。
DVOL_SHELL：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的接触体积内与壳相关的段。
DVOL_SOLID：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的接触体积内与实体相关的段。
PART：从部件 E1、E2、E3 生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。每个壳单元生成一个段；实体单元仅生成包围实体部件且指向部件外侧的段。为施加面力而定义二维段时，PART 可指梁部件。
PART_IO：从部件 E1、E2、E3 生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。与 PART 相同，但还生成部件内部的单元间段。在实体单元单面接触中，此选项有时有助于防止负体积。
PSLDFi：从实体部件 E1、E2、E3 的第 i 个面生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。面的定义参见下文表 0-1。
SALEBOXL：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格盒区域内的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 XMIN、XMAX、YMIN、YMAX、ZMIN、ZMAX，即 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 中定义的 S-ALE 网格各方向的最小和最大节点局部坐标。仅用于 S-ALE 网格，可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 配合，但不应与其他 GENERAL 选项配合。更多详情参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SALECPT：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格盒区域内的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX、KMIN、KMAX，即 S-ALE 网格各方向的最小和最大节点索引。若要包含 E1 所定义 S-ALE 网格中的所有段，将 E2–E7 设为零或留空。仅用于 S-ALE 网格，可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 配合，但不应与其他 GENERAL 选项配合。更多详情参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。

对于裁剪后的 S-ALE 网格（参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM），只要某段在指定方向上没有相邻单元，就将其视为表面段。因此集合包含朝向该方向的所有表面段，包括外边界和内边界。更多详情参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SEG：创建节点 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、E4 的段。
SET：纳入 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、... 的段集（*SET_SEGMENT）中的段。

SET_SOLID：从 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建、ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的实体单元集中的实体单元生成段。E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SLDIO：从 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建、ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的实体单元集中的实体单元生成段。E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性，同时生成外部和内部的段。
SET_SLDFi：从 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建、ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的实体单元集中的实体单元第 i 个面生成段。E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。面的定义参见下文表 0-1。
SET_TSHELL：从 *SET_TSHELL_LIST 创建、ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的厚壳单元集中的厚壳单元生成段。E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性，仅生成外部段。

SHELL：为 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的壳单元生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。
VOL：在 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。其他细节参见 BOX 选项，另见 *DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME。
VOL_SHELL：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的壳单元生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。
VOL_SLDIO：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的实体单元生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。其他细节参见 BOX_SLDIO。

BOX_SHELL：在 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的盒区域内生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。仅针对壳单元生成，每个壳单元生成一个段。
BOX_SLDIO：在 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的盒区域内生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。既生成外表面段，也生成单元间的段。
BOX_SOLID：在 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的盒区域内生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。仅针对外表面的实体单元生成段。
BRANCH：从树分支 E1、E2、E3 生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。每个壳单元生成一个段；实体单元仅生成包围实体部件且指向部件外侧的段。参见 *SET_PART_TREE。
BRANCH_IO：从树分支 E1、E2、E3 生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。与 BRANCH 相同，但还生成部件内部的单元间段。在实体单元之间使用单面接触时，此选项有时有助于防止负体积。
BRSLDFi：从实体树分支 E1、E2、E3 的第 i 个面生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。面的定义参见下文表 0-1。
DBOX：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的盒区域内的段。
DBOX_SHELL：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的盒区域内与壳相关的段。
DBOX_SOLID：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的盒区域内与实体相关的段。
DPART：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的部件的段。
DSEG：删除节点 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、E4 的段。
DSET：排除 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、... 的段集（*SET_SEGMENT）中的段。
DVOL：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的接触体积内的段。
DVOL_SHELL：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的接触体积内与壳相关的段。
DVOL_SOLID：排除 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的接触体积内与实体相关的段。
PART：从部件 E1、E2、E3 生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。每个壳单元生成一个段；实体单元仅生成包围实体部件且指向部件外侧的段。为施加面力而定义二维段时，PART 可指梁部件。
PART_IO：从部件 E1、E2、E3 生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。与 PART 相同，但还生成部件内部的单元间段。在实体单元单面接触中，此选项有时有助于防止负体积。
PSLDFi：从实体部件 E1、E2、E3 的第 i 个面生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。面的定义参见下文表 0-1。
SALECPT：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格盒区域内的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 分别对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX、KMIN、KMAX，即 S-ALE 网格各方向的最小和最大节点索引。仅用于结构化 ALE 网格，可与 SALEFAC 配合，但不应与其他 GENERAL 选项配合。更多详情参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SALEFAC：S-ALE 网格表面上的段。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 对应 -X、+X、-Y、+Y、-Z、+Z 面。将这 6 个值设为 1，可将相应面上的所有表面段纳入段集。仅用于 S-ALE 网格，可与 SALECPT 配合，但不应与其他 GENERAL 选项配合。对于裁剪后的 S-ALE 网格（参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM），只要某段在指定方向上没有相邻单元，就将其视为表面段。因此集合包含朝向该方向的所有表面段，包括外边界和内边界。更多详情参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
SEG：创建节点 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、E4 的段。
SET：纳入 ID 为 E1、E2、E3、... 的段集（*SET_SEGMENT）中的段。
SET_SHELL：从 *SET_SHELL_LIST 创建、ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的壳单元集中的壳单元生成段。E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SOLID：从 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建、ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的实体单元集中的实体单元生成段。E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。
SET_SLDIO：从 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建、ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的实体单元集中的实体单元生成段。E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性，同时生成外部和内部的段。
SET_SLDFi：从 *SET_SOLID_LIST 创建、ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的实体单元集中的实体单元第 i 个面生成段。E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性。面的定义参见下文表 0-1。
SET_TSHELL：从 *SET_TSHELL_LIST 创建、ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的厚壳单元集中的厚壳单元生成段。E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性，仅生成外部段。
SET_TSHIO：从 *SET_TSHELL_LIST 创建、ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的厚壳单元集中的厚壳单元生成段。E4、E5、E6、E7 设置属性，同时生成外部和内部的段。
SHELL：为 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的壳单元生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。
VOL：在 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。其他细节参见 BOX 选项，另见 *DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME。
VOL_SHELL：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的壳单元生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。
VOL_SLDIO：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的实体单元生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。其他细节参见 BOX_SLDIO。
VOL_SOLID：从 ID 为 E1、E2、E3 的接触体积内的实体单元生成段，属性值为 E4、E5、E6、E7。其他细节参见 BOX_SOLID。（原文 ID 列表中的省略号含编码乱码，需核对来源）。

english:
Applicable degrees of freedom:
EQ.1: x - translational degree of freedom for Cartesian systems(local or global).For a cylindrical or spherical system, this is the local radial degree of freedom r.To specify a local coordinate system, set VID to the negative of the local coordinate system ID.See Remark 9 and Figure 0 - 1.
EQ.2: y - translational degree of freedom for Cartesian systems(local or global).For a cylindrical system, this is the local circumferential degree of freedom ?, and for a spherical system, it is the local latitude degree of freedom ?.To specify a local coordinate system, set VID to the negative of the local coordinate system ID.See Remark 9 and Figure 0 - 1.
EQ.3: z - translational degree of freedom for Cartesian systems(local or global).For a cylindrical system, this is the local z - translational degree of freedom, and for a spherical system, it is the local longitude degree of freedom ?.To specify a local coordinate system, set VID to the negative of the local coordinate system ID.See Remark 9 and Figure 0 - 1.
EQ.4: Translational motion in the direction given by the VID.Movement on a plane normal to the vector is permitted.
EQ. - 4: Translational motion in the direction given by the VID.Movement on a plane normal to the vector is not permitted. In explicit analyses, this option only applies to rigid bodies if | CMO |= 2 on * MAT_RIGID or *CONSTRAINED_NODAL_RIGID_BODY.
EQ.5: x - rotational degree of freedom.For a cylindrical or spherical system, this is the local radial degree of freedom r.To specify a local coordinate system, set VID to the negative of the local coordinate system ID.See Remark 9 and Figure 0 - 1.
EQ.6: y - rotational degree of freedom.For a cylindrical system, this is the local circumferential degree of freedom ?, and for a spherical system, it is the local latitude degree of freedom ?.To specify a local coordinate system, set VID to the negative of the local coordinate system ID.See Remark 9 and Figure 0 - 1.
EQ.7: z - rotational degree of freedom.For a cylindrical system, this is the local z - translational degree of freedom, and for a spherical system, it is the local longitude degree of freedom ?.To specify a local coordinate system, set VID to the negative of the local coordinate system ID.See Remark 9 and Figure 0 - 1.
EQ.8: Rotational motion about an axis, parallel to vector VID,  passing through the center of gravity of the node, node set, or rigid body(or passing through a specified point when | CMO |= 2 on * MAT_RIGID or *CONSTRAINED_NODAL_RIGID_BODY).Rotation about the normal axes, namely, axes in a plane normal to VID, is permitted.
EQ. - 8: Rotational motion about an axis, parallel to vector VID,  passing through the center of gravity of the node, node set, or rigid body(or passing through a specified point when | CMO |= 2 on * MAT_RIGID or *CONSTRAINED_NODAL_RIGID_BODY).Rotation about the normal axes is not permitted.This option only applies to rigid bodies if | CMO |= 2.
EQ.9: Rotation with axis parallel to the x - axis and passing through the yz - plane at y = OFFSET1 and z = OFFSET2. Radial motion is NOT permitted.This option is not applicable to rigid bodies.
EQ. - 9: Rotation with axis parallel to the x - axis and passing through the yz - plane at y = OFFSET1 and z = OFFSET2. Radial motion is permitted.This option is not applicable to rigid bodies.
EQ.10: Rotation with axis parallel to the y - axis and passing through the zx - plane at z = OFFSET1 and x = OFFSET2. Radial motion is NOT permitted.This option is not applicable to rigid bodies.
EQ. - 10: Rotation with axis parallel to the y - axis and passing through the zx - plane at z = OFFSET1 and x = OFFSET2. Radial motion is permitted.This option is not applicable to rigid bodies.
EQ.11: Rotation with axis parallel to the z - axis and passing through the xy - plane at x = OFFSET1 and y = OFFSET2. Radial motion is NOT permitted.This option is not applicable to rigid bodies.
EQ. - 11: Rotation with axis parallel to the z - axis and passing through the xy - plane at x = OFFSET1 and y = OFFSET2. Radial motion is permitted.This option is not applicable to rigid bodies.
EQ.12: Translational motion in the direction given by the normals to the segments.This option is available only when using the SET_SEGMENT keyword option.

english:
Blocking options:
EQ.0:	Off. Blocking is not considered.
EQ.1:	Elements with nonzero contact forces are fully blocked, meaning porosity and venting leakage are set to zero. 
EQ.4:	Venting leakage is not affected by contact forces, meaning blocking is not considered at vents. Porosity leakage is set to zero for elements with nonzero contact forces.
EQ.11:	Venting leakage is set to zero for vent elements with nonzero contact forces. Porosity leakage is scaled by a factor that depends on the ratio of contact pressure to gas pressure.
EQ.14:	Venting leakage is not affected by contact forces, meaning blocking is not considered at vents. Porosity leakage is scaled by a factor that depends on the ratio of contact pressure to gas pressure.

EQ.4：排气泄漏不受接触力影响，即排气孔不考虑堵塞。接触力非零单元的多孔泄漏设为零。
EQ.11：接触力非零的排气孔单元，其排气泄漏设为零。多孔泄漏按一个取决于接触压力与气体压力之比的系数缩放。
EQ.14：排气泄漏不受接触力影响，即排气孔不考虑堵塞。多孔泄漏按一个取决于接触压力与气体压力之比的系数缩放。

english:
Correlation structure:
EQ.1:	3D isotropic.  The x, y and z correlations are described using one correlation function. Define one instance of Card 2d.1.
EQ.2:	3D product.  The x, y and z correlations are described using a correlation function each. Define three instances of Card 2d.1.
EQ.3:	2D isotropic.  A correlation function describes the x correlation while the yz isotropic relationship is described using another correlation function. Define two instances of Card 2d.1.
EQ.4:	2D isotropic.  The xz isotropic relationship is described using a correlation function, while another correlation function describes the y correlation function. Define two instances of Card 2d.1 .
EQ.5:	2D isotropic.  The xy isotropic relationship is described using a correlation function, while another correlation function describes the z correlation function. Define two instances of Card 2d.1.
EQ.6:	3D elliptic.  Define ELLIP1, ELLIP2, and one instance of Card 2d.1. 
EQ.7:	2D elliptic.  A correlation function describes the x correlation while the yz elliptic relationship is described using another correlation function. Define ELLIP1 and two instances of Card 2d.1.
EQ.8:	2D elliptic.  A correlation function describes the y correlation, while the zx elliptic relationship is described using another correlation function. Define ELLIP1 and two instances of Card 2d.1.
EQ.9:	2D elliptic.  The xy elliptic relationship is described using a correlation function, while another correlation function describes the z correlation function. Define ELLIP1 and two instances of Card 2d.1.
localized:
相关结构：
EQ.1：三维各向同性。用一个相关函数描述 x、y、z 方向的相关性。定义一张卡片 2d.1。
EQ.2：三维乘积形式。x、y、z 方向的相关性各用一个相关函数描述。定义三张卡片 2d.1。
EQ.3：二维各向同性。用一个相关函数描述 x 方向相关性，另一个描述 yz 平面内的各向同性关系。定义两张卡片 2d.1。
EQ.4：二维各向同性。用一个相关函数描述 xz 平面内的各向同性关系，另一个描述 y 方向相关性。定义两张卡片 2d.1。
EQ.5：二维各向同性。用一个相关函数描述 xy 平面内的各向同性关系，另一个描述 z 方向相关性。定义两张卡片 2d.1。
EQ.6：三维椭圆形式。定义 ELLIP1、ELLIP2 和一张卡片 2d.1。
EQ.7：二维椭圆形式。用一个相关函数描述 x 方向相关性，另一个描述 yz 平面内的椭圆关系。定义 ELLIP1 和两张卡片 2d.1。
EQ.8：二维椭圆形式。用一个相关函数描述 y 方向相关性，另一个描述 zx 平面内的椭圆关系。定义 ELLIP1 和两张卡片 2d.1。
EQ.9：二维椭圆形式。用一个相关函数描述 xy 平面内的椭圆关系，另一个描述 z 方向相关性。定义 ELLIP1 和两张卡片 2d.1。

english:
Define the type of EOS:
EQ.1: Permeability defined by B as a function of H curve (B=?H). The abscissa of the curve is H, and the ordinate is B.
EQ.2: Permeability defined by a H function of B curve(H = B / ?).The abscissa of the curve is B, and the ordinate is H.
EQ.3 : Permeability defined by a load curve where B - H curves(B = ?H) may be defined as a function of von Mises stress.The abscissa of the curve is von Mises stress, and the ordinate is a load curve ID for the B - H load curves.The abscissa for each B - H load curve is H, and the ordinate is B.
EQ.4 : Permeability defined by a load curve where B - H load curves(B = ?H) may be defined as a function of temperature.The abscissa of the curve is temperature, and the ordinate is load curve ID for the B - H load curves.The abscissa for each B - H load curve is H, and the ordinate is B.
EQ.5 : Permeability defined by a load curve where B - H curves(B = µH) may be defined as a function of an equivalent stress model calculated from uniaxial stress.The abscissa of the curve is uniaxial stress; the ordinate is a load curve ID for the B - H load curves.The abscissa for each B - H load curve is H, and the ordinate is B.See Remark 4.
EQ.7: Permeability given by an analytical arctan law defining B as a function of H and optionally temperature.See Remark 1.
EQ.8 : Permeability given by the Froelich law defining B as a function of H and optionally temperature.See Remark 2.
EQ.31 : Same as 3, except the signed von Mises stress is used.
localized:
定义 EOS 类型：
EQ.1：通过 B 随 H 变化的曲线定义磁导率（B=?H）。曲线横坐标为 H，纵坐标为 B。
EQ.2：通过 H 随 B 变化的曲线定义磁导率（H = B / ?）。曲线横坐标为 B，纵坐标为 H。
EQ.3：用载荷曲线将 B-H 曲线（B = ?H）定义为 von Mises 应力的函数，从而定义磁导率。外层曲线横坐标为 von Mises 应力，纵坐标为 B-H 载荷曲线 ID。各 B-H 曲线横坐标为 H，纵坐标为 B。
EQ.4：用载荷曲线将 B-H 曲线（B = ?H）定义为温度的函数，从而定义磁导率。外层曲线横坐标为温度，纵坐标为 B-H 载荷曲线 ID。各 B-H 曲线横坐标为 H，纵坐标为 B。
EQ.5：用载荷曲线将 B-H 曲线（B = µH）定义为由单轴应力计算的等效应力模型的函数，从而定义磁导率。外层曲线横坐标为单轴应力，纵坐标为 B-H 载荷曲线 ID。各 B-H 曲线横坐标为 H，纵坐标为 B。参见备注 4。
EQ.7：通过解析 arctan 定律定义磁导率，将 B 定义为 H 以及可选的温度的函数。参见备注 1。
EQ.8：通过 Froelich 定律定义磁导率，将 B 定义为 H 以及可选的温度的函数。参见备注 2。
EQ.31：同 EQ.3，但使用带符号的 von Mises 应力。

english:
EQ.ALL: All nodes will be included in the set. 
EQ.BRANCH: Nodes inside tree branches E1, E2, E3,  will be included.  (see *SET_PART_TREE) 
EQ.DBRANCH: Previously added nodes that are inside tree branches E1, E2, E3,  will be excluded.
EQ.BOX: Nodes inside boxes E1, E2, E3,  will be included.  (see *DEFINE_BOX) 
EQ.DBOX: Previously added nodes that are inside boxes E1, E2, E3,  will be excluded. 
EQ.NODE: Nodes E1, E2, E3,  will be included. 
EQ.DNODE: Nodes E1, E2, E3,  if previously added will be excluded. 
EQ.PART: Nodes of parts E1, E2, E3,  will be included. 
EQ.DPART: Nodes that have been previously added and are of parts E1, E2, E3,  will be excluded. 
EQ.SALECPT: Nodes inside a box in a structured ALE (S-ALE) mesh. E1 here is the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN, JMAX, KMIN, KMAX.  They are the minimum and the maximum nodal indices along each direction in S-ALE mesh.  This option can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options. Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.  
EQ.SALEFAC: Nodes that are on the face of an S-ALE mesh.  E1 gives the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to -x, +x, -y, +y, -z, +z faces.  Assigning 1, for instance, to these six values would include nodes belonging to all the surface segments at these faces in the node set.  This option is can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options. For trimmed S-ALE meshes (see *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM), a segment is treated as a surface segment as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.  The set, thus, includes the nodes of surface segments belonging to exterior and interior boundaries.Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.  
EQ.SALEBOXL: Nodes inside a box in a structured ALE (S-ALE) mesh. E1 here is the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to XMIN, XMAX, YMIN, YMAX, ZMIN, and ZMAX.  They are the minimum and the maximum nodal local coordinates, as defined in *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS, along each direction in an S-ALE mesh.  This option can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.  
EQ.SET_NODE: Nodes from node sets with IDs E1, , E7 will be included.
EQ.DSET_NODE: Nodes that have been previously added and are from node sets with IDs E1, , E7 will be excluded. 
EQ.SET_XXXX: Include nodal points of element sets defined by *SET_XXXX, where XXXX could be SHELL, SOLID, BEAM, TSHELL, or DISCRETE.
EQ.SET_PART: Include nodal points in part sets E1, , E7. 
EQ.VOL: Nodes inside contact volumes E1, E2, E3,  will be included.  See *DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME.
EQ.DVOL: Previously added nodes that are inside contact volumes E1, E2, E3,  will be excluded.
localized:
EQ.ALL：将所有节点纳入集合。
EQ.BRANCH：纳入树分支 E1、E2、E3、... 中的节点（参见 *SET_PART_TREE）。
EQ.DBRANCH：排除先前加入且位于树分支 E1、E2、E3、... 中的节点。
EQ.BOX：纳入盒区域 E1、E2、E3、... 内的节点（参见 *DEFINE_BOX）。
EQ.DBOX：排除先前加入且位于盒区域 E1、E2、E3、... 内的节点。
EQ.NODE：纳入节点 E1、E2、E3、...。
EQ.DNODE：排除先前加入的节点 E1、E2、E3、...。
EQ.PART：纳入部件 E1、E2、E3、... 的节点。
EQ.DPART：排除先前加入且属于部件 E1、E2、E3、... 的节点。
EQ.SALECPT：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格盒区域内的节点。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX、KMIN、KMAX，即 S-ALE 网格各方向的最小和最大节点索引。仅用于 S-ALE 网格，可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 配合，但不应与其他 GENERAL 选项配合。更多详情参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
EQ.SALEFAC：S-ALE 网格表面上的节点。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 对应 -x、+x、-y、+y、-z、+z 面。例如，将这六个值设为 1，会将相应面上所有表面段的节点纳入节点集。仅用于 S-ALE 网格，可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 配合，但不应与其他 GENERAL 选项配合。对于裁剪后的 S-ALE 网格（参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM），只要某段在指定方向上没有相邻单元，就将其视为表面段，因此集合包含外边界和内边界表面段的节点。更多详情参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
EQ.SALEBOXL：结构化 ALE（S-ALE）网格盒区域内的节点。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5、E6、E7 对应 XMIN、XMAX、YMIN、YMAX、ZMIN、ZMAX，即 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 中定义的 S-ALE 网格各方向的最小和最大节点局部坐标。仅用于 S-ALE 网格，可与 SALECPT、SALEFAC、SALEBOXL 配合，但不应与其他 GENERAL 选项配合。更多详情参见 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS 和 *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH。
EQ.SET_NODE：纳入 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的节点集中的节点。
EQ.DSET_NODE：排除先前加入且来自 ID 为 E1、...、E7 的节点集的节点。
EQ.SET_XXXX：纳入由 *SET_XXXX 定义的单元集中的节点，其中 XXXX 可为 SHELL、SOLID、BEAM、TSHELL 或 DISCRETE。
EQ.SET_PART：纳入部件集 E1、...、E7 中的节点。
EQ.VOL：纳入接触体积 E1、E2、E3、... 内的节点。参见 *DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME。
EQ.DVOL：排除先前加入且位于接触体积 E1、E2、E3、... 内的节点。（原文 ID 列表中的省略号含编码乱码，需核对来源）。

EQ.PART: Nodes of parts E1, E2, E3,  will be included. 
EQ.DPART: Nodes that have been previously added and are of parts E1, E2, E3,  will be excluded. 
EQ.SALECPT: Nodes inside a box in a structured ALE (S-ALE) mesh. E1 here is the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN, JMAX, KMIN, KMAX.  They are the minimum and the maximum nodal indices along each direction in S-ALE mesh. To include all nodes in the S-ALE mesh defined by E1, set values E2E7 to zero or leave them blank. This option can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options. Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.  
EQ.SALEFAC: Nodes that are on the face of an S-ALE mesh.  E1 gives the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, E7 correspond to -x, +x, -y, +y, -z, +z faces.  Assigning 1, for instance, to these six values would include nodes belonging to all the surface segments at these faces in the node set.  This option is can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options. For trimmed S-ALE meshes (see *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_TRIM), a segment is treated as a surface segment as long as it has no neighboring element along the specified direction.  The set, thus, includes the nodes of surface segments belonging to exterior and interior boundaries.Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.  
EQ.SALEBOXL: Nodes inside a box in a structured ALE (S-ALE) mesh. E1 here is the S-ALE mesh ID (MSHID).  E2, E3, E4, E5, E6, and E7 correspond to XMIN, XMAX, YMIN, YMAX, ZMIN, and ZMAX.  They are the minimum and the maximum nodal local coordinates, as defined in *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS, along each direction in an S-ALE mesh.  This option can only be used for S-ALE meshes. It can be used with options SALECPT, SALEFAC, and SALEBOXL but should not be used with other GENERAL options.Please refer to *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH_CONTROL_POINTS and *ALE_STRUCTURED_MESH for more details.  
EQ.SET_NODE: Nodes from node sets with IDs E1, , E7 will be included.
EQ.DSET_NODE: Nodes that have been previously added and are from node sets with IDs E1, , E7 will be excluded. 
EQ.SET_XXXX: Include nodal points of element sets defined by *SET_XXXX, where XXXX could be SHELL, SOLID, BEAM, TSHELL, or DISCRETE.
EQ.SET_PART: Include nodal points in part sets E1, , E7. 
EQ.VOL: Nodes inside contact volumes E1, E2, E3,  will be included.  See *DEFINE_CONTACT_VOLUME.
EQ.DVOL: Previously added nodes that are inside contact volumes E1, E2, E3,  will be excluded.

I0.EQ.CRNT: Current
I0.EQ.CRNTRTE: Current rate
I0.EQ.FX: Electromotive force along x
I0.EQ.FY: Electromotive force along y
I0.EQ.FZ: Electromotive force along z
EQ.ICVOL: Information reported in ICVOUT for incompressible control volume I1, see *DEFINE_CONTROL_VOLUME, including
I0.EQ.PRES: Temperature of control volume
I0.EQ.VOL: Volume of control volume
EQ.JNTSTG:	Information reported in JNTFORC for general stiffness joint I1, see CONSTRAINED_JOINT_STIFFNESS_GENERALIZED, including
I0.EQ.PHI:	rotation Ï in degree
I0.EQ.PHIR:	rate of rotation Ï 
I0.EQ.THETA:	rotation Î¸ in degree
I0.EQ.THETAR:	rate of rotation Î¸ 
I0.EQ.IPSI:	rotation Ï in degree.
I0.EQ.PSIR:	rate of rotation Ï
EQ.MATSUM: Information reported in MATSUM for part set I1, including:
I0.EQ.ADDMASS: Added mass
I0.EQ.ERODEIE: Eroded internal energy
I0.EQ.ERODEKE: Eroded kinetic energy
I0.EQ.HOURGLASS:	Hourglass energy
I0.EQ.INTERNAL: Internal energy
I0.EQ.KINETIC: Kinetic energy
EQ.NFAILE: Number of failed elements of type I0 in set I1. I0, element type, can be  SOLID

BEAM  for beam elements or  DISC  for discrete elements. I1 is the related element set

english:
Flag for cohesive elements to control deletion, the time step estimate, and the element type used in implicit and explicit. Breaking LS-DYNA convention, ICOH is interpreted digit-wise, namely as,
ICOH = [MLK] = K + 10×L + 100×M .
The first digit(in the ones place), K, is interpreted as follows:
K.EQ.0: No cohesive element deletion due to neighbor failure.
K.EQ.1: Solid elements having ELFORM = 19 - 22 (or ELFORM = 1, 2, 15 being used with *MAT_169) are eroded when neighboring shell or solid elements fail.This works for nodewise connected partsand tied contacts.
The second digit(in the tens place), L, controls how the mass used to estimate the element time step is computed.L defaults to zero if ICOH is less than 10 (having a single digit).See Remark 1.
L.EQ.0: The mass is the sum of the element nodes.Each node is assumed to be shared between two elements.
L.EQ.1: The mass is computed by integrating the cohesive density.
L.EQ.2: Same as the default (0), but each node is assumed to be shared by four elements.Compared to the default, the time step is reduced by a factor of 1 / ?2.
L.EQ.3: The element connectivity is used to compute how much(nodal) mass is associated with each element, meaning no assumption regarding connectivity is made.This setting is recommended.
The third digit(in the hundreds place), M, is interpreted as follows:
M.EQ.0: Explicit element variants used in explicit calculations and higher - accuracy implicit element variants used in implicit calculations.
M.EQ.1: Higher - accuracy implicit element variants used in both implicit and explicit calculations.
localized:
内聚单元标志，控制删除、时间步估计，以及隐式和显式计算使用的单元类型。不同于 LS-DYNA 的通常约定，ICOH 按数位解释：
ICOH = [MLK] = K + 10×L + 100×M。
第一位（个位）K：
K.EQ.0：不因相邻单元失效而删除内聚单元。
K.EQ.1：ELFORM = 19 - 22 的实体单元，或与 *MAT_169 配合使用的 ELFORM = 1、2、15 实体单元，在相邻壳或实体单元失效时删除。适用于通过共节点连接的部件和绑定接触。
第二位（十位）L 控制估计单元时间步所用质量的计算方式。若 ICOH 小于 10（仅一位数），L 默认为零。参见备注 1。
L.EQ.0：质量为单元各节点质量之和，假定每个节点由两个单元共享。
L.EQ.1：通过对内聚单元密度积分计算质量。
L.EQ.2：与默认值 0 相同，但假定每个节点由四个单元共享。与默认设置相比，时间步按因子 1 / ?2 缩小（原文此处符号缺失，需核对手册）。
L.EQ.3：依据单元连接关系计算分配给每个单元的节点质量，不对连接关系作假设。推荐此设置。
第三位（百位）M：
M.EQ.0：显式计算采用显式单元变体，隐式计算采用精度更高的隐式单元变体。
M.EQ.1：隐式和显式计算均采用精度更高的隐式单元变体。
sourceIssue: 时间步比例因子 1 / ?2 符号缺失

english:
Flag for element (material) history data provided as input quantities in subroutine usrfrc (see comments there).
EQ.0: A special choice of element history variables is provided, namely plastic strain, yield stress, and material directions. 
GT.0: Plastic strain and element history variables up to NEHIS-1 are provided in original order.
localized: 控制作为输入量传入 usrfrc 子程序的单元（材料）历史数据的标志（见该子程序注释）。EQ.0：提供专门选定的单元历史变量，即塑性应变、屈服应力和材料方向。GT.0：按原始顺序提供塑性应变以及直到 NEHIS-1 的单元历史变量。

english:
Flag for interpolation. INTP is interpreted digit-wise, namely as,
INTP=[LK]=K+10×L
The first digit, K, controls the interpolation method:
EQ.0: linear (default), 
EQ.1: uniform  (not recommended for asymmetrical arrangement of the upper and lower nodes),
EQ.2: inverse distance weighting.
EQ.3: Quadratic.
The second digit, L, controls if the nodal area is considered when computing the weight:
L.EQ.0: Nodal area is not considered (default),
L.EQ.1: Nodal area is considered.
localized:
插值标志。INTP 按数位解释：INTP=[LK]=K+10×L。
第一位 K 控制插值方法：
EQ.0：线性（默认值）。
EQ.1：均匀（不建议用于上下节点不对称布置的情况）。
EQ.2：反距离加权。
EQ.3：二次。
第二位 L 控制计算权重时是否考虑节点面积：
L.EQ.0：不考虑节点面积（默认值）。
L.EQ.1：考虑节点面积。

english:
Flag for interpolation. INTP is interpreted digit-wise, namely as,:
INTP = [LK] = K + 10×L
The first digit, K, controls the interpolation method :
K.EQ.0 : Linear(default)),
K.EQ.1:	Uniform(not recommended for an asymmetrical arrangement of the upper and lower nodes)),
K.EQ.2:	Inverse distance weighting
The second digit, L, controls if the nodal area is considered when computing the weight :
L.EQ.0 : Nodal area is not considered(default),
L.EQ.1 : Nodal area is considered.
localized:
插值标志。INTP 按数位解释：INTP=[LK]=K+10×L。
第一位 K 控制插值方法：
K.EQ.0：线性（默认值）。
K.EQ.1：均匀（不建议用于上下节点不对称布置的情况）。
K.EQ.2：反距离加权。
第二位 L 控制计算权重时是否考虑节点面积：
L.EQ.0：不考虑节点面积（默认值）。
L.EQ.1：考虑节点面积。

english:
Flag for specifying where the exterior surface of the airbag is when the exterior is made of shell elements. This exterior surface is used to determine the volume of the airbag. 
EQ.0:	The exterior surface is taken as the mid - plane of the shell(default).
EQ.1 : The exterior surface is offset from the mid - plane of the shell by half the shell elements thickness.
localized: 气囊外部由壳单元构成时，指定其外表面位置的标志。该外表面用于确定气囊体积。EQ.0：以壳中面为外表面（默认）。EQ.1：外表面相对壳中面偏移半个壳单元厚度（原文所有格符号乱码，需核对手册）。

english:
Flag for specifying whether the immersed interface remains unchanged (static) during the simulation:
EQ.0:The immersed interface is dynamic. Frequent interface computations are needed. Note that *ICFD_BOUNDARY_IMMERSED_STATIC and *ICFD_BOUNDARY_IMMERSED_DYNAMIC take precedence over this option. .
EQ.1:The immersed interface is static. The interface is computed at the first time step or after re-meshing steps only. This option saves computation time.Note that this option takes precedence over *ICFD_BOUNDARY_IMMERSED_STATIC and *ICFD_BOUNDARY_IMMERSED_DYNAMIC
localized:
指定浸入界面在仿真期间是否保持不变（静态）的标志：
EQ.0：浸入界面为动态，需要频繁进行界面计算。注意，*ICFD_BOUNDARY_IMMERSED_STATIC 和 *ICFD_BOUNDARY_IMMERSED_DYNAMIC 优先于此选项。
EQ.1：浸入界面为静态，仅在第一个时间步或重网格步骤之后计算界面。此选项可节省计算时间。注意，此选项优先于 *ICFD_BOUNDARY_IMMERSED_STATIC 和 *ICFD_BOUNDARY_IMMERSED_DYNAMIC。

english:
Flag for the evaluation of the damping force/moment as a function of velocity curves on Card 4:
EQ.0:	Use absolute value of velocity (default). The curves only need to be defined in the first positive quadrant. 
EQ.1:	Use signed value of velocity. The curves must define the response in the negative and positive quadrants and pass through point (0,0). This allows the definition of different damping behavior in tension and compression.
localized:
控制卡片 4 上阻尼力/力矩随速度变化曲线求值方式的标志：
EQ.0：使用速度的绝对值（默认值）。曲线只需在第一象限内定义。
EQ.1：使用带符号的速度值。曲线必须定义正、负象限内的响应，且通过点 (0,0)。这样可定义不同的拉伸和压缩阻尼行为。

english:
Flag for treatment of eroded nodes in contact.  An eroded node is a node that is no longer attached to any element after an element deletion.  ENMASS is not supported by all contact types; it is suggested that the user toggle on Show Deleted Nodes in LS-PrePost when postprocessing to display eroded nodes as particles, and in so doing, determine if ENMASS affects the contact behavior.  ENMASS is not supported when SOFT = 2 on Optional Card A of *CONTACT. 
EQ.0:	Eroded nodes are not considered in the contact algorithm.
EQ.1 : Eroded nodes of solid elements remain active in the contact algorithm.
EQ.2 : Eroded nodes of solid and shell elements remain active in the contact algorithm.
localized:
接触中侵蚀节点的处理标志。侵蚀节点指在单元删除后不再连接任何单元的节点。并非所有接触类型均支持 ENMASS；建议后处理时在 LS-PrePost 中开启“Show Deleted Nodes”，将侵蚀节点显示为粒子，以判断 ENMASS 是否影响接触行为。当 *CONTACT 的可选卡片 A 中 SOFT = 2 时，不支持 ENMASS。
EQ.0：接触算法不考虑侵蚀节点。
EQ.1：实体单元的侵蚀节点在接触算法中保持活动。
EQ.2：实体和壳单元的侵蚀节点在接触算法中保持活动。（原文 Show Deleted Nodes 两侧的引号含编码乱码，需核对来源）。
sourceIssue: 原文 Show Deleted Nodes 两侧的引号含编码乱码

english:
Flag for weighting factors of the control points.
WFL = 0: All weights at the control points are set to 1 and no optional cards D are allowed.
WFL != 0: The weights at the control points are de ned in optional cards
D which must be de ned after cards C..
localized: 控制点权重系数标志。WFL = 0：所有控制点的权重设为 1，且不允许可选卡片 D。WFL != 0：控制点权重在可选卡片 D 中定义，D 必须在卡片 C 后定义（原文单词中含异常控制字符，需核对手册）。

english:
Flag to activate a vectorized version of the original implementation, resulting in a reduction of computational effort by up to 30%.
EQ.0.0: Original scalar implementation.
EQ.1.0 : Vectorized implementation.
EQ.2.0:	Same as VFAST=1 but in addition faster curve/table evaluation by using the re-discretized curves. This is mandatory for LCID-T referring to a 3D table. The combination of VFAST=2 and LCID-B>0 is not supported (internal switch back to VFAST=1).
localized:
用于启用原实现的向量化版本的标志，可将计算开销最多降低 30%。
EQ.0.0：原标量实现。
EQ.1.0：向量化实现。
EQ.2.0：同 VFAST=1，并通过重新离散化的曲线加快曲线/表求值。当 LCID-T 引用三维表时，必须使用此选项。不支持 VFAST=2 与 LCID-B>0 的组合（内部将切回 VFAST=1）。

english:
Flag to add free convection terms to the k  ? and k ? models. See Remark 5.
EQ.0:	Default.Same as 2.
EQ.1 : Include free convection terms.
EQ.2 : Do not include free convection terms.
localized: 向 k - ? 和 k - ? 模型添加自然对流项的标志。见备注 5。EQ.0：默认，同 2。EQ.1：包括自然对流项。EQ.2：不包括自然对流项（原文模型符号缺失且连接符乱码，需核对手册）。

english:
Flag to control definition of soil stress for Cards 4a through 6a and Cards 4b through 6b:
EQ.0: Use time - varying soil stress.TIMSTR is ignored.
EQ.1: Use time - varying soil stress until time TIMSTR.Then use the soil stress that existed at time TIMSTR for the remainder of the analysis.
localized: 控制卡片 4a 至 6a 和卡片 4b 至 6b 中土体应力定义的标志：EQ.0：使用随时间变化的土体应力，忽略 TIMSTR。EQ.1：在 TIMSTR 时刻之前使用随时间变化的土体应力，此后在剩余分析期间使用 TIMSTR 时刻的土体应力。

english:
Flag to control the output of an adaptive mesh and d3plot in 3D r-adaptivity:
EQ.0: Do not output an adaptive mesh output at exit and do not write d3plot files beforeand after each adaptive step. 
EQ.1: Output the adaptive mesh at exit, but do not write d3plot files beforeand after each adaptive step. 
EQ.2: Output d3plot files after each adaptive step, but do not output an adaptive mesh at exit. 
EQ.3: Output d3plot files before and after each adaptive step, but do not output an adaptive mesh at exit.Use this option for metal flow lines.
localized:
控制三维 r 自适应中自适应网格和 d3plot 输出的标志：
EQ.0：退出时不输出自适应网格，每个自适应步前后均不写出 d3plot 文件。
EQ.1：退出时输出自适应网格，但每个自适应步前后均不写出 d3plot 文件。
EQ.2：每个自适应步后输出 d3plot 文件，但退出时不输出自适应网格。
EQ.3：每个自适应步前后均输出 d3plot 文件，但退出时不输出自适应网格。金属流线应使用此选项。

english:
Flag to define PCFC methods:
EQ.0: Simplified Approximate Nearest Neighbor(SANN) (default)
EQ.1 : Neural network(NN)
localized: 定义 PCFC 方法的标志：EQ.0：简化近似最近邻 (SANN)（默认）。EQ.1：神经网络 (NN)。

english:
Flag to determine whether P1 through P7 on this card are constants or refer to a load curve ID:
EQ.0 : P1 through P7 are constants.
EQ.1 : P1 through P7 refer to load curve IDs.Each curve is the respective parameter as a function temperature.
localized: 确定本卡片 P1 到 P7 是常数还是载荷曲线 ID 的标志：EQ.0：P1 到 P7 为常数。EQ.1：P1 到 P7 为载荷曲线 ID，各曲线给出相应参数随温度的变化关系。

english:
Flag to determine whether the damping is applied to excess pore pressure in parts referenced by *BOUNDARY_PORE_FLUID, see Remarks:
EQ.0: Same as EQ.1
EQ.1: Excess pore pressure is subjected to damping ratio CDAMPV
EQ.2: Damping is not applied to pore pressure, only to the effective stress.
localized: 确定是否对 *BOUNDARY_PORE_FLUID 引用部件的超孔隙压力施加阻尼的标志，见备注。EQ.0：同 EQ.1。EQ.1：对超孔隙压力施加阻尼比 CDAMPV。EQ.2：不对孔隙压力施加阻尼，仅对有效应力施加阻尼。

english:
Flag to enable adaptive user control files:
EQ.0: No user control files
EQ.1: Perform run - time control on 3D adaptivity through control files
See details of this option in Manual Volume IV: Multiscale Solvers
localized: 启用自适应用户控制文件的标志：EQ.0：无用户控制文件。EQ.1：通过控制文件在运行时控制 3D 自适应。详见手册第 IV 卷：多尺度求解器。

english:
Flag to exclude beam-to-beam contact from the same PID for CONTACT_AUTOMATIC_GENERAL. The global default may be set using CPARM8 on MPP1 of *CONTACT__MPP.
EQ.0: Flag is not set(default).
EQ.1: Flag is set.
EQ.2: Flag is set.CPARM8 = 2 has the additional effect of permitting contact treatment of spot weld(type 9) beams in AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts; spot weld beams are otherwise disregarded entirely by AUTOMATIC_GENERAL contacts.
localized:
用于在 CONTACT_AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 中排除同一 PID 内梁-梁接触的标志。全局默认值可通过 *CONTACT_…_MPP 的 MPP1 卡片上的 CPARM8 设置。
EQ.0：不设置此标志（默认值）。
EQ.1：设置此标志。
EQ.2：设置此标志。CPARM8 = 2 还允许 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触处理点焊梁（类型 9）；否则 AUTOMATIC_GENERAL 接触会完全忽略点焊梁。（原文 *CONTACT_…_MPP 中的省略号含编码乱码，需核对来源）。
sourceIssue: 原文 *CONTACT_…_MPP 中的省略号含编码乱码

english:
Flag to govern behavior of the output frequency load curve defined by LCUR:
EQ.1: When output is generated at time t_n, the next output time t_(n + 1) is computed as
?(2 / 2) t_(n + 1) = t_n + LCUR (t_n)  .
This is the default behavior.
EQ.2: When output is generated at time t_n, the next output time t_(n + 1) is computed as
?(2 / 2) t_(n + 1) = t_n + LCUR (t_(n + 1))  .
EQ.3: Output is generated for each abscissa point in the load curve definition.The actual value of the load curve is ignored.
localized:
控制由 LCUR 定义的输出频率载荷曲线行为的标志：
EQ.1：在时刻 t_n 生成输出后，下一输出时刻 t_(n + 1) 按下式计算：
?(2 / 2) t_(n + 1) = t_n + LCUR(t_n)。这是默认行为。
EQ.2：在时刻 t_n 生成输出后，下一输出时刻 t_(n + 1) 按下式计算：
?(2 / 2) t_(n + 1) = t_n + LCUR(t_(n + 1))。
EQ.3：在载荷曲线定义的每个横坐标点生成输出，忽略载荷曲线的实际值。（原文公式前缀“?(2 / 2)”不完整，需核对来源。）
sourceIssue: 原文含乱码、缺失符号、引用错误或关键字拼写问题，需核对来源。

english:
Flag to identify which free end of a pile is treated as the base: 
EQ.1: End with the most negative global Z - coordinate
EQ.2: End which is Node 1 of the attached beam element topology.
localized: 指定将桩的哪个自由端作为桩底的标志：EQ.1：全局 Z 坐标最负的一端。EQ.2：所连接梁单元拓扑中的节点 1 所在端。

english:
Flag to reset the body load in the fluid:
EQ.0:	The body load provided in * LOAD_?BODY is reset to zero only for the fluid analysis. In addition, by specifying DIR and VAL, the body load on the fluid can be specified.
EQ.1 : Do not reset the body load provided in * LOAD_?BODY.
localized: 重置流体中体载荷的标志：EQ.0：仅对流体分析，将 *LOAD_?BODY 提供的体载荷重置为零；也可通过 DIR 和 VAL 指定流体体载荷。EQ.1：不重置 *LOAD_?BODY 提供的体载荷（原文关键字含缺失符号，需核对手册）。

Flag to select which elements to trim, that is, "outside" or "inside" the specified object defined with the OPTION and En.
For PARTSET and SEGSET options, "outside" is defined as the region to which the segment normal points.
EQ.0: outside (default)

Flag to specify initial conditions using *DEFINE_FUNCTION:
EQ.0:	Not in use.
EQ.1 : All values for initial velocity, pressure, temperature, etc.now refer to* DEFINE_FUNCTION IDs.In these functions, the following parameters are allowed : f(x, y, z).Thus, each variables initial profile is a function of position.

english: For OPTION = 7, ±9, 10, ±11 only.  Normal energy release rate (stress × length) used in the damage calculation; see Lemmen and Meijer [2001]. english:
Geometry types.See the table below for more details: 
The "GEOM column in the table below enumerates the allowed values for the geometry variable as well as describing E1, , E6 for each geometry type.  Each of the following operations accepts up to 6 arguments but may take fewer.  Values of En left unspecified are ignored.
CPT Mesh region defined by control points.E1 is the minimum control point along the x - axis.E2 is the maximum control point along the x - axis.E3 is the minimum control point along the y - axis.E4 is the maximum control point along the y - axis.E5 is the minimum control point along the z - axis.E6 is the maximum control point along the z - axis.
REPLACE Fill a part in an Eulerian mesh region with the material from a part that has a dummy mesh superimposed on the Eulerian mesh.The dummy mesh specifies the Eulerian mesh region.The dummy mesh has part ID PID.The dummy mesh should be made of shells in 2D and solids in 3D. * SECTION_EFV with ELFORM = 9 and *EFV_MAT should specify the part section and material for PID, respectively.E1 is the material part in the Eulerian mesh region to be replaced by the material in PID.
BOX* DEFINE_BOX ID that defines a box to fill with the material from PID.*SECTION_EFV with ELFORM = 9 and *EFV_MAT should specify the part section and material for PID, respectively.E2 is the material part in the box to be replaced by the material in PID.
CYLINDER Define a cylinder to fill with the material from PID.*SECTION_EFV with ELFORM = 9 and *EFV_MAT should specify the part section and material for PID, respectively.E1and E2 are the node IDs that locate the base centers.E3and E4 are the base radii.E5 is the number of nodes along the base circumferences.E6 is the material part in the cylinder to be replaced by the material in PID.
SPHERE Define a sphere or ellipsoid to fill with the material from PID. * SECTION_EFV with ELFORM = 9 and *EFV_MAT should specify the part section and material for PID, respectively.E1 is the node ID giving the center of the sphere or ellipsoid.E6 is the ID of a local coordinate system(see * DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM).E2, E3,and E4 are the radii in each direction of this coordinate system.They can be different to form an ellipsoid.E5 is the number of nodes along the circumference.E6 is the material part in the sphere / ellipsoid to be replaced by the material in PID.
SEGSET Use segments to specify the boundary of a geometry to be filled with the material from PID. * SECTION_EFV with ELFORM = 9 and *EFV_MAT should specify the part section and material for PID, respectively.E1 is the set ID of the segments(see * SET_SEGMENT) that define the boundary of the geometry to fill.E2 is the material part in the geometry to be replaced by the material in PID.
RECTANGLE In 2D, fill a rectangle defined between 2 corners with the smallest coordinates(XMIN, YMIN) and largest coordinates(XMAX, YMAX).E1 is a switching flag to determine whether to fill the interior or exterior of the rectangle.E1 = 0 means fill the interior while E1 = 1 means fill the exterior.E2, E3, E4,and E5 are XMIN, XMAX, YMIN,and YMAX, respectively.
QUAD In 2D, fill a quadrilateral defined by 4 nodes: E2, E3, E4,and E5.The node numbering of the quadrilateral must be counterclockwise around the boundary.E1 is a switching flag to determine whether to fill the interior or exterior of the rectangle.E1 = 0 means fill the interior while E1 = 1 means fill the exterior.
ELLIPSE In 2D, fill an ellipse centered at the point(XC, YC) with the semi - axis along the X - axis DX and the semi - axis along the Y - axis DY.E1 is a switching flag to flip the side to fill(by default E1 = 0, if E1 = 1 fill the other side).E2 = XC, E3 = YC, E4 = DX, E5 = DY.
PARABOLA In 2D, fill a side of a parabola defined by X = AY ** 2 + BY + C.E1 is a flag setting which side of the parabola to fill.For E1 = 0, the side of the parabola with convex geometry is filled, meaning any two points in region can be connected with a line segment that remains in the region.For E1 = 1, concave geometry side of the parabola is filled.See Figure 0 - 1. Here, E2, E3,and E4 specify A, B,and C, respectively.
HALFSPACE In 2D, fill the region on one side of a line defined by the points(E2, E3) and (E4, E5) in x - y space.E1 determines the region filled.When E1 = 0, the region on the left side of the line is filled when going along the line from the point(E2, E3) to the point(E4, E5).When E1 = 0, the region on the right side of the line is filled.
UNUSED Mesh region defined by control points where the elements are unused.E1 is the minimum control point along the x - axis.E2 is the maximum control point along the x - axis.E3 is the minimum control point along the y - axis.E4 is the maximum control point along the y - axis.E5 is the minimum control point along the z - axis.E6 is the maximum control point along the z - axis.PID is ignored for this case.Materials occupying the elements are removed.
localized:
几何类型，详情如下。GEOM 列列出允许的几何变量值，并说明每种几何类型的 E1、...、E6。每项操作最多接受 6 个参数，也可少于 6 个；未指定的 En 值忽略。
CPT：由控制点定义的网格区域。E1、E2 分别为沿 x 轴的最小、最大控制点；E3、E4 分别为沿 y 轴的最小、最大控制点；E5、E6 分别为沿 z 轴的最小、最大控制点。
REPLACE：用一个部件的材料填充欧拉网格区域中的某部件。该材料部件具有叠加在欧拉网格上的虚拟网格，用于指定欧拉网格区域。虚拟网格的部件 ID 为 PID，二维使用壳单元，三维使用实体单元。PID 的截面与材料应分别由 ELFORM = 9 的 *SECTION_EFV 和 *EFV_MAT 定义。E1 为欧拉网格区域中将被 PID 材料替换的材料部件。
BOX：*DEFINE_BOX ID 定义要用 PID 材料填充的盒区域。PID 的截面与材料应分别由 ELFORM = 9 的 *SECTION_EFV 和 *EFV_MAT 定义。E2 为盒区域中将被 PID 材料替换的材料部件。
CYLINDER：定义用 PID 材料填充的圆柱。PID 的截面与材料应分别由 ELFORM = 9 的 *SECTION_EFV 和 *EFV_MAT 定义。E1、E2 为确定两端底面中心的节点 ID；E3、E4 为两端底面半径；E5 为沿底面圆周的节点数；E6 为圆柱内将被 PID 材料替换的材料部件。
SPHERE：定义用 PID 材料填充的球或椭球。PID 的截面与材料应分别由 ELFORM = 9 的 *SECTION_EFV 和 *EFV_MAT 定义。E1 为球或椭球中心的节点 ID。原文将 E6 定义为局部坐标系 ID（参见 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM），E2、E3、E4 为该坐标系各方向的半径，可取不同值形成椭球；E5 为沿圆周的节点数。原文又将 E6 定义为球/椭球内将被 PID 材料替换的材料部件。E6 定义冲突，需核对手册。
SEGSET：用段指定要以 PID 材料填充的几何边界。PID 的截面与材料应分别由 ELFORM = 9 的 *SECTION_EFV 和 *EFV_MAT 定义。E1 为定义填充区域边界的段集 ID（参见 *SET_SEGMENT）；E2 为该几何区域中将被 PID 材料替换的材料部件。
RECTANGLE：在二维中填充由最小坐标角点 (XMIN, YMIN) 与最大坐标角点 (XMAX, YMAX) 定义的矩形。E1 决定填充内侧或外侧：E1 = 0 填充内部，E1 = 1 填充外部。E2、E3、E4、E5 分别为 XMIN、XMAX、YMIN、YMAX。
QUAD：在二维中填充由节点 E2、E3、E4、E5 定义的四边形。节点必须沿边界按逆时针顺序编号。E1 决定填充内侧或外侧：E1 = 0 填充内部，E1 = 1 填充外部。
ELLIPSE：在二维中填充中心为 (XC, YC)、沿 X 轴半轴长为 DX、沿 Y 轴半轴长为 DY 的椭圆。E1 用于反转填充侧，默认为 E1 = 0，E1 = 1 时填充另一侧。E2 = XC，E3 = YC，E4 = DX，E5 = DY。
PARABOLA：在二维中填充抛物线 X = AY ** 2 + BY + C 的一侧。E1 指定填充侧：E1 = 0 填充构成凸区域的一侧，即区域内任意两点的连线段均位于区域内；E1 = 1 填充凹区域一侧。参见图 0-1。E2、E3、E4 分别指定 A、B、C。
HALFSPACE：在二维 x-y 空间中，以 (E2, E3) 和 (E4, E5) 两点定义直线，填充其一侧区域。E1 决定填充区域。原文称 E1 = 0 时，填充沿 (E2, E3) 指向 (E4, E5) 的左侧；随后又称 E1 = 0 时填充右侧。两项条件冲突，需核对手册。
UNUSED：由控制点定义、其中单元不再使用的网格区域。E1、E2 分别为沿 x 轴的最小、最大控制点；E3、E4 分别为沿 y 轴的最小、最大控制点；E5、E6 分别为沿 z 轴的最小、最大控制点。此时忽略 PID，并移除占据这些单元的材料。

english: Global value for the average rotational mass. For finite element nodes without rotational mass (such as those belonging to solid elements), an average value is calculated internally (using the existing rotational masses of all shells and beams in the model) and assigned to each of these nodes, such as for penalty tied contacts. This value is written to the d3hsp file during initialization (... get an average value of RMAVG = ...). Sometimes this value is too small, leading to instabilities in the tied contact. In these cases, the value should be chosen accordingly higher. Alternatively, RINRT = 1 can be used on *CONTROL_SOLID.
localized: 平均转动质量的全局值。对于没有转动质量的有限元节点（如实体单元节点），程序根据模型中所有壳和梁的现有转动质量在内部计算平均值，并赋给这些节点，例如用于罚函数绑定接触。初始化时，此值写入 d3hsp 文件（“… get an average value of RMAVG = …”）。有时该值过小，会导致绑定接触不稳定，此时应相应增大取值。也可在 *CONTROL_SOLID 中设置 RINRT = 1。（原文 d3hsp 输出示例两侧的引号含编码乱码，需核对来源）。

english: Initial mesh remapping factor for PRTYPE=8 only, ranging between 0.0 and 1.0.  When EFAC approaches 1.0, the remapping approaches pure Eulerian behavior.  The smaller the value of EFAC, the closer the mesh will initially follow the material flow in the vicinity of a shock front, i.e. approaching Lagrangian behavior.  Thus, a very small value might lead to severe mesh distortions because the mesh must deform severely to follow the material flow initially.  Eventually over time, the mesh smoothing behavior will approach an Eulerian system
localized: 初始网格重映射系数，仅用于 PRTYPE=8，取值范围为 0.0 至 1.0。EFAC 趋近 1.0 时，重映射趋近纯欧拉行为。EFAC 越小，网格初始阶段越贴随冲击波前沿附近的材料流动，即趋近拉格朗日行为。因此，取值很小时可能导致严重网格畸变，因为网格起初必须大幅变形才能跟随材料流动。最终，随着时间推移，网格平滑行为会趋近欧拉系统。

english:
Load curve ID or Table ID. 
Load Curve.  When LCSS is a load curve ID, it defines effective stress as a function of effective plastic strain. If defined EPS1 - EPS8 and ES1 - ES8 are ignored.
Tabular Data.The table ID defines for each strain rate value a load curve ID giving the stress versus effective plastic strain for that rate, See Figure Error!Reference source not found..When the strain rate falls below the minimum value, the stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the lowest value of strain rate is used.Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value, the stress versus effective plastic strain curve for the highest value of strain rate is used.Fields C, P, LCSR, EPS1 - EPS8, and ES1 - ES8 are ignored if a Table ID is defined.Linear interpolation between the discrete strain rates is used by default; logarithmic interpolation is used when the LOG_INTERPOLATION option is invoked.
Logarithmically Defined Tables.An alternative way to invoke logarithmic interpolation between discrete strain rates is described as follows.If the first value in the table is negative, LS - DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of a strain rate.Since the tables are internally discretized to equally space the table values, it makes good sense from an accuracy standpoint that the table values represent the natural log of strain rate when the lowest strain rate and highest strain rate differ by several orders of magnitude.There is some additional computational cost associated with invoking logarithmic interpolation.
localized:
载荷曲线 ID 或表 ID。
载荷曲线：LCSS 为载荷曲线 ID 时，定义等效应力随等效塑性应变的变化。定义后忽略 EPS1 - EPS8 和 ES1 - ES8。
表数据：表为每个应变率指定一条应力随等效塑性应变变化的载荷曲线 ID（原文图交叉引用缺失）。应变率低于最小值时，采用最低应变率对应的应力-等效塑性应变曲线；超过最大值时，采用最高应变率对应的曲线。若定义表 ID，则忽略 C、P、LCSR、EPS1 - EPS8 和 ES1 - ES8。默认在离散应变率之间采用线性插值；启用 LOG_INTERPOLATION 选项时采用对数插值。
对数定义的表：还可通过以下方式启用离散应变率之间的对数插值。若表中第一个值为负，LS-DYNA 假定所有表值均表示应变率的自然对数。由于内部离散化会使表值等间距，当最低与最高应变率相差几个数量级时，从精度角度建议采用应变率的自然对数作为表值。启用对数插值会增加一定计算开销。

Tabular Data.The table maps in - plane strain rate values(Î³ Ì_ab) to a load curve giving the in - plane shear stress as a function of the absolute value of in - plane shear strain.Note that except for in the case of logarithmically definied tables, the strain ratesand shear strains must be the absolute values(see Remark 5).For strain rates below the minimum value, the curve for the lowest defined value of strain rate is used.Likewise, when the strain rate exceeds the maximum value, the curve for the highest defined value of strain rate is used.

english: Load curve, table, or 3D table ID. If specifying a load curve ID, it defines the yield stress as a function of plastic strain. These curves should be obtained from quasi-static and (optionally) dynamic uniaxial tensile tests.  This input is mandatory, and the material model will not work unless at least one tensile stress-strain curve is given.  If LCID-T is a table ID, the table values are plastic strain rates, and a curve of yield stress versus plastic strain must be given for each of those strain rates.  If the first value in the table is negative, LS-DYNA assumes that all the table values represent the natural logarithm of plastic strain rate. When the highest plastic strain rate is several orders of magnitude greater than the lowest, it is recommended that the natural log of plastic strain rate be input in the table. If LCID-T is a 3D table ID, uniaxial yield stress is given as a function of history variable #8 (3D table), strain rate (table), and equivalent plastic strain (curve). History variable #8 could represent a user-defined value - such as porosity, hardness, etc. - and its spatial distribution can be initialized using the keywords *INITIAL_STRESS or *INITIAL_HISTORY. For the 3D table option to work, the option VFAST=2 on card 5 must be used and LCID-B>0 is not supported. See Remark 4.
localized:
载荷曲线、表或三维表 ID。若指定载荷曲线 ID，则定义屈服应力随塑性应变的变化。曲线应由准静态以及可选的动态单轴拉伸试验获得。此输入为必需项；若未给出至少一条拉伸应力-应变曲线，材料模型无法工作。
若 LCID-T 为表 ID，则表值为塑性应变率，且每个应变率均须对应一条屈服应力随塑性应变变化的曲线。若表中第一个值为负，LS-DYNA 假定所有表值均表示塑性应变率的自然对数。当最高塑性应变率比最低值高出几个数量级时，建议在表中输入塑性应变率的自然对数。
若 LCID-T 为三维表 ID，则单轴屈服应力为历史变量 #8（三维表）、应变率（表）和等效塑性应变（曲线）的函数。历史变量 #8 可表示孔隙率、硬度等用户定义值，其空间分布可通过 *INITIAL_STRESS 或 *INITIAL_HISTORY 初始化。要使用三维表选项，必须在卡片 5 上设置 VFAST=2，且不支持 LCID-B>0。参见备注 4。

english:
Mass moment of inertia for the six degree of freedom discrete beam and scalar (MAT_146) beam.  This parameter does not apply to cable elements.  This lumped inertia is partitioned equally between the two nodes of the element. See Remarks 12 and 13.
GT.0.0: Inertia partitioned to the nodes.
EQ. -1: The element inertia is computed as a solid sphere of volume VOL. This inertia, which is reported to d3hsp, is then partitioned to the nodes.
EQ.-2: The element inertia is computed such that the rotational time step matches the translational. Currently only available for *MAT_196. The computed element inertias are written to the message file(s).
localized:
六自由度离散梁和标量梁（MAT_146）的质量转动惯量。此参数不适用于索单元。该集中惯量在单元的两个节点之间等分。见备注 12 和 13。
GT.0.0：将惯量分配到节点。
EQ.-1：将单元视为体积为 VOL 的实心球计算惯量。此惯量写入 d3hsp，然后分配到节点。
EQ.-2：计算单元惯量，使转动时间步与平动时间步一致。目前仅适用于 *MAT_196。计算所得单元惯量写入消息文件。

english:
Material axes option for phase i, see Figure M2-1. 
EQ.0.0: locally orthotropic with material axes determined by element nodes as shown in part (a) of Figure M2-1. The a-direction is from node 1 to node 2 of the element. The b-direction is orthogonal to the a-direction and is in the plane formed by nodes 1, 2, and 4. When this option is used in two-dimensional planar and axisymmetric analysis, it is critical that the nodes in the element definition be numbered counterclockwise for this option to work correctly. 
EQ.1.0: locally orthotropic with material axes determined by a point in space and the global location of the element center; this is the a-direction. This option is for solid elements only. 
EQ.2.0: globally orthotropic with material axes determined by vectors defined below, as with *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR. 
EQ.3.0: locally orthotropic material axes determined by rotating the material axes about the element normal by an angle,
BETA, from a line in the plane of the element defined by the cross product of the vector v with the element normal. 
The plane of a solid element is the midsurface between the inner surface and outer surface defined by the first four nodes and the last four nodes of the connectivity of the element, respectively. 
EQ.4.0: locally orthotropic in cylindrical coordinate system with the material axes determined by a vector v, and an originating point, P, which define the centerline axis. This option is for solid elements only. 
LT.0.0: the absolute value of AOPT is a coordinate system ID number (CID on *DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES,
*DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM or *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR). Available in R3 version of 971 and later.
localized:
第 i 相的材料轴选项，参见图 M2-1。
EQ.0.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由单元节点确定，如图 M2-1 的 (a) 所示。a 方向从单元节点 1 指向节点 2；b 方向垂直于 a 方向，并位于节点 1、2、4 构成的平面内。在二维平面或轴对称分析中使用此选项时，单元定义中的节点必须按逆时针顺序编号，才能保证该选项正确工作。
EQ.1.0：局部正交各向异性，材料轴由空间中的一点及单元中心的全局位置确定，此方向即 a 方向。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
EQ.2.0：全局正交各向异性，材料轴由下方定义的向量确定，与 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 相同。
EQ.3.0：局部正交各向异性。向量 v 与单元法向量的叉积确定单元平面内的一条线；以该线为基准，绕单元法向旋转 BETA 角来确定材料轴。实体单元的平面为其中面，位于由单元连接关系中前四个节点定义的内表面与后四个节点定义的外表面之间。
EQ.4.0：柱坐标系中的局部正交各向异性。材料轴由向量 v 和起点 P 确定，二者定义中心线轴。此选项仅适用于实体单元。
LT.0.0：AOPT 的绝对值为坐标系 ID（*DEFINE_COORDINATE_NODES、*DEFINE_COORDINATE_SYSTEM 或 *DEFINE_COORDINATE_VECTOR 中的 CID）。适用于 971 的 R3 及更高版本。

english:
OPT Failure option:
EQ.-2: same as option -1 but in addition, the peak value of the failure criteria and the time it occurs is stored and is written into the SWFORC database. This information may be necessary since the instantaneous values written at specified time intervals may miss the peaks. Additional storage is allocated to store this information. 
EQ.-1: resultant based failure criteria, FC, is computed based on the force and moment resultants and is written into the SWFORC file. Failure is not allowed. This allows easy identification of vulnerable spot welds in the post-processing. Failure is likely to occur if FC >1.0. Only the terms where the corresponding failure resultant is nonzero are included when FC is calculated. This option applies to both solid and beam elements. 
EQ. 0: resultant based failure
EQ. 1: stress based failure computed from resultants (Toyota)
EQ. 2: user subroutine to determine failure 
EQ. 3: notch stress based failure (beam weld only)
EQ. 4: stress intensity factor at failure (beam weld only)
EQ. 5: structural stress at failure (beam weld only). 
EQ. 6: stress based failure computed from resultants (Toyota). In this option a shell strain rate dependent failure model is used (beam weld only). The static failure stresses are defined by part ID using the input given in the keyword definition *DEFINE_SPOTWELD_ RUPTURE_STRESS input. 
EQ. 7: stress based failure for solid elements (Toyota) with peak stresses computed from resultants, and strength values input for pairs of parts, see *DEFINE_SPOTWELD_FAILURE_ RESULTANTS. Strain rate effects are optional. 
EQ. 8: Not used. 
EQ. 9: Stress based failure from resultants (Toyota). In this option a shell strain rate dependent failure model is used (beam weld only). The static failure stresses are defined by part ID using the input given in the keyword definition *DEFINE_SPOTWELD_ RUPTURE_PARAMETER input.
localized:
OPT 失效选项：
EQ.-2：同选项 -1，另外存储失效准则的峰值及其发生时间，并写入 SWFORC 数据库。按指定时间间隔输出的瞬时值可能遗漏峰值，因此可能需要这些信息；程序会分配额外存储空间。
EQ.-1：基于合力和合力矩计算失效准则 FC，并写入 SWFORC 文件，但不允许失效，便于后处理中识别薄弱点焊。FC >1.0 时可能发生失效。计算 FC 时，仅计入对应失效合力或合力矩非零的项。适用于实体和梁单元。
EQ.0：基于合力和合力矩的失效。
EQ.1：由合力和合力矩计算的基于应力的失效（Toyota）。
EQ.2：由用户子程序确定失效。
EQ.3：基于缺口应力的失效（仅用于梁焊点）。

OPTION.EQ.SALECPT:Elements inside a box for a 2D Structured ALE mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4,and E5 correspond to IMIN, IMAX, JMIN,and JMAX, respectively.They are the minimumand the maximum nodal indices along each direction in the S - ALE mesh. To include all shells in the S-ALE mesh defined by E1, set values E2E7 to zero or leave them blank. This option is only to be used for a Structured ALE mesh.It can be used with SALEFAC to generate a shell set but should not be used with other "_GENERAL" options. 
OPTION.EQ.SALEFAC:Elements on the face of a 2D Structured ALE mesh.E1 is the S - ALE mesh ID(MSHID).E2, E3, E4, and E5 correspond to the - X, +X, -Y, and +Y faces, respectively.Assigning 1 to these 4 values would include all the boundary elements at these faces in the shell element set.This option is only to be used for a Structured ALE mesh.It can be used with SALECPT to generate a shell set but should not be used with other "_GENERAL" options.

OPTION.EQ.DBOX：从当前集合排除先前加入、位于盒区域 E1...E7 内的壳单元。
OPTION.EQ.SALECPT：二维结构化 ALE 网格盒区域内的单元。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5 分别对应 IMIN、IMAX、JMIN、JMAX，即 S-ALE 网格各方向的最小和最大节点索引。若要包含 E1 所定义 S-ALE 网格中的所有壳单元，将 E2–E7 设为零或留空。此选项仅用于结构化 ALE 网格，可与 SALEFAC 配合生成壳单元集，但不应与其他 _GENERAL 选项配合使用。
OPTION.EQ.SALEFAC：二维结构化 ALE 网格边界面上的单元。E1 为 S-ALE 网格 ID（MSHID）；E2、E3、E4、E5 分别对应 -X、+X、-Y、+Y 面。将这 4 个值设为 1，可将相应面上的所有边界单元纳入壳单元集。此选项仅用于结构化 ALE 网格，可与 SALECPT 配合生成壳单元集，但不应与其他 _GENERAL 选项配合使用。

OPTION.EQ.SET：纳入梁单元集 E1、E2、E3、... 中的单元。
OPTION.EQ.DSET：排除先前加入且属于梁单元集 E1、E2、E3、... 的单元。

english:
Optional contact thickness. For SOFT = 2, it applies to solids, shells, and beams. For SOFT = 0 and 1 and Mortar contacts, it only applies to shells and beams.
However, for the MPP version only, OPTT does affect the contact behavior of solid elements for SOFT = 0 and 1 but not by changing the contact thickness.
In the case of MPP with SOFT = 0 and 1 for solids, OPTT overrides the thickness of the solid elements used for the calculation of the
contact penetration release (see Table Error! Reference source not found.) but does not affect the contact thickness. This is not available in SMP.
OPTT does not affect the contact thickness when applied to the parts on the tracked side (SURFA) of an AUTOMATIC_NODES_TO_SURFACE contact.
However, it affects the contact thickness of this type of contacts reference side (SURFB).
localized:
可选接触厚度。SOFT = 2 时适用于实体、壳和梁。SOFT = 0、1 以及 Mortar 接触时，仅适用于壳和梁。
但仅在 MPP 版本中，OPTT 也会影响 SOFT = 0、1 时实体单元的接触行为，不过并非通过改变接触厚度。
在 MPP 中，对 SOFT = 0、1 的实体，OPTT 覆盖计算接触穿透释放时所用的实体单元厚度（原文表引用错误：“Error! Reference source not found.”），但不影响接触厚度。SMP 不支持此功能。
将 OPTT 应用于 AUTOMATIC_NODES_TO_SURFACE 接触被跟踪侧（SURFA）的部件时，不影响接触厚度；但它会影响该接触参考侧（SURFB）的接触厚度。（原文表引用需核对来源。）

english:
PARTSET : Trim by Lagrange part set.  E1 is the shell or solid part set ID.  E2 is the distance.  Elements farther away than the distance in the direction of the shell or solid outer face normal vectors are deleted/kept (depending on the value of IOUTIN). Note that only elements on one side will be deleted. To delete the elements on both sides, repeat the card with the IOUTIN value reversed. 
SEGSET :Trim by Lagrange segment set.  E1 is the segment set ID.  E2 is the distance.  Elements farther away than the distance in the direction of the segment normal vectors are deleted/kept (depending on the value of IOUTIN). Note that only elements on one side will be deleted. To delete both sides, repeat the card with the IOUTIN value reversed.
SLDSET :Trim by Lagrange solid set.  E1 is the solid set ID. E2 is the distance.  Elements farther away than the distance in the direction of the solid outer face normal vectors (depending on the value of IOUTIN) are deleted/kept. Note that only elements on one side will be deleted. To delete both sides, repeat the card with the IOUTIN value reversed.
SHLSET :Trim by Lagrange shell set.  E1 is the shell set ID. E2 is the distance.  Elements farther away than the distance in the direction of the shell face normal vectors in 3D (or shell outer side normal vectors in 2D) are deleted/kept (depending on the value of IOUTIN). Note that only elements on one side will be deleted. To delete both sides, repeat the card with the IOUTIN value reversed.
BEAMSET :Trim by beam set for a 2D mesh.  E1 is the beam set ID. E2 is the distance.  Elements farther away than the distance in the direction of the beam normal vectors are deleted/kept (depending on the value of IOUTIN). Note that only elements on one side will be deleted. To delete both sides, repeat the card with the IOUTIN value reversed.
PLANE :Trim by plane.  E1 is the node ID of a node on the plane.  E2 is another node ID off the plane.  And vector E2  E1 is normal to the plane. Note that outside the plane is the portion of the mesh to which the planes normal vector points, and inside the plane is the portion of the mesh on the other side of the plane.
CYLINDER :Trim by CYLINDER. E1 and E2 are node IDs of the center nodes at two ends.  E3 and E4 are the radius at those two ends.
BOXCOR :Trim by box.  E1 is the box ID. Please refer to *DEFINE_BOX for details on setting up a box in the global coordinate system or *DEFINE_BOX_LOCAL in the local coordinate system.
BOXCPT :Trim by box. The box is defined using S-ALE control points (CPT).  E1 is box ID. Please refer to *DEFINE_BOX for details on setting up a box. 
SPHERE :Trim by sphere.  E1 is the node ID of the sphere center node.  E2 is the radius of the sphere.
localized:
PARTSET：按拉格朗日部件集裁剪。E1 为壳或实体部件集 ID，E2 为距离。沿壳或实体外表面法向、距离超过该值的单元将被删除或保留，由 IOUTIN 决定。注意仅删除一侧单元；若要删除两侧单元，应重复此卡片并反转 IOUTIN 的值。
SEGSET：按拉格朗日段集裁剪。E1 为段集 ID，E2 为距离。沿段法向、距离超过该值的单元将被删除或保留，由 IOUTIN 决定。仅删除一侧；若要删除两侧，应重复此卡片并反转 IOUTIN 的值。
SLDSET：按拉格朗日实体单元集裁剪。E1 为实体单元集 ID，E2 为距离。沿实体外表面法向、距离超过该值的单元将被删除或保留，由 IOUTIN 决定。仅删除一侧；若要删除两侧，应重复此卡片并反转 IOUTIN 的值。
SHLSET：按拉格朗日壳单元集裁剪。E1 为壳单元集 ID，E2 为距离。沿三维壳表面法向或二维壳外侧边法向、距离超过该值的单元将被删除或保留，由 IOUTIN 决定。仅删除一侧；若要删除两侧，应重复此卡片并反转 IOUTIN 的值。
BEAMSET：按梁单元集裁剪二维网格。E1 为梁单元集 ID，E2 为距离。沿梁法向、距离超过该值的单元将被删除或保留，由 IOUTIN 决定。仅删除一侧；若要删除两侧，应重复此卡片并反转 IOUTIN 的值。
PLANE：按平面裁剪。E1 为平面上一节点的 ID，E2 为平面外另一节点的 ID，向量 E2 - E1 为平面法向。平面“外侧”是法向量所指向的网格部分，“内侧”为另一侧。
CYLINDER：按圆柱裁剪。E1、E2 为两端中心节点的 ID，E3、E4 为对应两端的半径。
BOXCOR：按盒区域裁剪。E1 为盒区域 ID。全局坐标系中的定义方式参见 *DEFINE_BOX，局部坐标系中的定义方式参见 *DEFINE_BOX_LOCAL。
BOXCPT：按由 S-ALE 控制点（CPT）定义的盒区域裁剪。E1 为盒区域 ID。定义方式参见 *DEFINE_BOX。
SPHERE：按球裁剪。E1 为球心节点 ID，E2 为球半径。（原文 E2 与 E1 之间的连接符、引号及所有格符号含编码乱码，需核对来源）。

The load curve value multiplies the coefficient value FD.For Mortar contact the temperature defining the scale factor Image is the mean temperature Image in the interface, if using a table one can prescribe the coefficient as an arbitrary function of both, i.e., Image. For this latter option, define a curve using Image as abscissa for each value of Image.
localized:
用于定义动摩擦系数随温度变化的载荷曲线编号。载荷曲线值乘以系数 FD。
对于 Mortar 接触，用于定义比例因子的温度 Image 是接触界面的平均温度 Image；若使用表，可将系数规定为这两个量的任意函数，即 Image。对于后一种选项，为每个 Image 值定义一条以 Image 为横坐标的曲线。

localized:

对于 Mortar 接触，用于定义比例因子的温度 Image 是接触界面的平均温度 Image；若使用表，可将系数规定为这两个量的任意函数，即 Image。对于后一种选项，为每个 Image 值定义一条以 Image 为横坐标的曲线。
